conclusions: Use true user-level posterior with prior for equal-cost AER when meaningful; finite approximation needs calibration checks.
Do not force all algorithms to expose the same statistic.
Keep native reference readouts and label any calibrated postprocessor as an adaptation.
Physical noise is not effective estimation-error covariance.
Current cached data can support limited offline energy readout comparison; not arbitrary posterior or block-SBL reconstruction.
